name: Sparse Voxel Octree Path Tracing
definition: A rendering technique that traverses a Sparse Voxel Octree structure on the CPU to perform path tracing, writing results to a texture displayed via OpenGL.
summary: Sparse Voxel Octree Path Tracing is a CPU-based rendering technique that traverses a sparse voxel octree to perform path tracing, distinguishing itself by executing all ray marching and shading calculations on the host processor rather than the GPU.
